dataset.name: SAGES Critical View of Safety Challenge 2024 dataset
dataset.download: 2026-10-16, huggingface_hub snapshot_download pinned to the revision above; 3225/3225 files present with byte sizes matching repository metadata; all 1000 videos SHA256-identical to the repository LFS hashes
dataset.citation: Alapatt D, et al. arXiv:2509.17100 (2025). https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.17100

license.name: CC BY-NC 4.0
license.implications: non-commercial use only; sharing and adaptation allowed with attribution and no added restrictions, so de-identified row-level labels/predictions may be shared for this non-commercial study; not usable for a commercial product

evaluation_partition.split: official test (predefined by the organizers; full reference labels publicly released)
evaluation_partition.split_method_per_paper: random split of 1,000 cases into 700 train / 300 test (Fig. 3 caption)

schema.frame_id_definition: 0-indexed sequential decode index at 30 fps; labelled frame_ids 0..2550 step 150 (every 5 s, 18 per clip)
schema.rater_identity: rater1..3 are column positions, not fixed individuals (official README)
schema.majority_rule: pre-specified 2-of-3; all labels binary and complete, so majority is always defined
schema.readme_vs_files: README says annotated every 5 s; files confirm 18 frames per 90-s clip (paper: 18 frames)

extra_non_data_files.note: macOS '._*' and LibreOffice '.~lock.*#' artefacts shipped in the repository; ignored

missing_and_anomalies.visible_overlays: at least one test clip (664a48be..., duplicate of c8063d76...) shows an on-screen date/time stamp

frame_alignment_qa.method: official tools/preprocess_videos.py (--fps 0.2) vs the PNG frames used in this study on 3 clips; aligned frame must be closer than frames i-1 and i+1

deduplication.frozen_at: 2026-10-16 21:36:04 +0800, before any model training or SAGES inference
deduplication.rule: same footage if video SHA256 identical, or >=5 of 90 one-per-second frames have a pHash neighbour <=4 bits in the other clip at a modal frame offset of 0, confirmed by visual side-by-side review
deduplication.primary_rule: keep the lexicographically smallest clip_id per footage group (label-blind)
deduplication.note: several duplicate pairs carry different rater labels for the same footage (independent re-annotation)

operation_and_patient_identity.paper_statement: "1,000 laparoscopic cholecystectomy cases, each represented by a 90-second clip" (Sec. 4.2)
operation_and_patient_identity.procedure_level_mapping: not provided; clip treated as the case/operation unit after footage deduplication
operation_and_patient_identity.patient_independence: not stated by the organizers; cannot be verified from released data
operation_and_patient_identity.status: limitation: clusters are footage groups (clip level); patient-level independence not confirmed

endoscapes_overlap.paper: no statement on excluding previously published datasets; contributing hospitals not named; author affiliations include IHU Strasbourg / University of Strasbourg (Endoscapes2023 origin)
endoscapes_overlap.screen_method: 64-bit DCT pHash; all 27,000 one-per-second frames of the 300 SAGES test clips vs all 58,813 frames of the official Endoscapes2023 zip (SHA256 0574b11a...); calibration below

screen.note: adjacent = consecutive Endoscapes frames of one video <=25 source-frame-index apart, both non-black

endoscapes_overlap.visual_review: top-6 closest pairs (Hamming 4-6) plus the 4 closest frames of the only clip whose near neighbours concentrated on one Endoscapes video (f1c28c63... -> video 122) were reviewed side by side: all show different procedures/scenes (similarity driven by the circular endoscopic vignette). No near-identical footage found.
endoscapes_overlap.positive_control: the same method found all 7 SAGES-internal duplicate footage groups (6 at 0-bit distance on most frames); one re-encoded/colour-altered duplicate matched only 6/90 frames at <=4 bits, so heavily altered copies can be partially missed
endoscapes_overlap.limitations: cannot detect same patient/procedure in a different time window, cropped or colour-graded copies, or same-centre overlap
endoscapes_overlap.status: no near-identical footage found by the screen; independence not confirmed by the dataset maintainers
endoscapes_overlap.interpretation: cross-dataset transfer; patient independence not established
